name: web-cream-page-pricing-faq-and-cta-with-hard-shadow-cards
title: Butter-cream pricing, FAQ and CTA sections with black-outlined hard-shadow cards, yellow tags and raspberry buttons
whatItIs: A butter-cream page with a bold 'Pricing Plans' heading and a raspberry monthly-yearly toggle, three white cards with thick outlines and hard shadows each with a yellow tag (Free, Popular, Custom), big prices, raspberry buttons and feature lists, a two-column FAQ with bold questions, a big yellow outlined CTA card with a raspberry button and a footer with newsletter and link columns.
whatItMeans: Friendly and punchy; outlines, shadows and raspberry make forms and prices feel like stickers.
techniques: Give every card a thick outline and hard shadow.
Use small yellow tags on plans.
Fill a full-width yellow CTA card.

vocabulary.definition: A small yellow label on a plan card.
A large coloured card with one action.
Questions and answers in two columns.
